review_method: Read-only review of 14 local source decks (166 slides); candidate-image visual inspection; ten original PNG/JPEG files copied byte-for-byte; no PCB/EDA/hardware execution
role_basis: Individual measurement-PCB circuit/layout/routing and HFSS role are stated in the author's research portfolio slide 6. Shared USB PCB and lab-common modeling records are labeled separately; authorship of every team routing change is not inferred.
scope_notes: Seven selected LPDDR/measurement images come from the author portfolio and three from a shared USB PCB progress deck.
HFSS screenshot is a geometric model, not an electric-field/current-density distribution.

PCB_cutout1 and PCB_cutout6 have different model names and vertical-axis ranges; controlled before/after boundary conditions and exact geometry change are not fully documented. No notch-removal causality or percentage improvement claimed.

LPDDR plot at 6.4 GHz marks six transfer responses about -1.58 to -2.14 dB. Slide text has omitted minus signs for DQ2/DQ3; guide uses values visible in plot and does not reproduce the ambiguous per-DQ text mapping.
USB source summary 1.11/1.25 dB at 12.8 GHz is loss magnitude. Individual plotted clock responses are -1.12/-1.11 dB and data responses -1.25/-1.26 dB; these are PCB simulation results.
HFSS curves, fabricated-board/COB photos, instrument-setup photos and joint silicon Eye/BER are separate evidence types.
Eye values comparing active-lane counts are not used as PCB-revision improvement evidence.
Ground-via/power-connectivity layout review is not represented as power-integrity simulation or signoff.

Initial surrogate-channel/SMA decks, copied connector datasheets, detailed chip layouts and bonding pin maps, vendor material documents, private paths and native PCB/Gerber/HFSS files excluded from publication.
All selected images retain their embedded bytes and original annotations; large board photo remains original-resolution PNG.
